description: Ausschreibungsagenten.de searches current public procurement notices for the German-speaking market and the wider EU. It covers German federal above- and below-threshold notices through service.bund.de and Datenservice Öffentlicher Einkauf, all 27 EU member states including Germany and Austria through TED, and the United Kingdom through Find a Tender and Contracts Finder. Users can filter by keyword, buyer country, CPV code, deadline window and contract value, open a single notice in full, read a labelled AI summary in German or English, check which portals are connected and how fresh each one is, and see which countries currently hold the most open procedures. Built for contractors, agencies and bid teams in Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Every result carries the link to the authoritative original notice, which always prevails over anything shown here.
